checks.description: Frontmatter has exactly name and description, name matches the directory.
checks.rule: YAML frontmatter contains keys name and description only; name equals 'build-vs-buy-eval'.

checks.description: Checks for an existing tool before proposing to build.
checks.rule: Body requires checking for an existing framework or tool first, borrowing before inventing.

checks.description: Arabic capability is the decisive filter for generative tools.
checks.rule: Body states that for any generative tool, Arabic capability (no tatweel, Western numerals, RTL-safe) is the decisive filter applied before other criteria, and a candidate that fails it is ruled out regardless of other strengths.

checks.description: Candidates are scored on a fixed set of criteria.
checks.rule: Body and scorecard define a fixed criteria set including Arabic capability, SOP fit, GCC/PDPL data fit, cost vs volume, integration effort, lock-in/exit, and maturity/support.

checks.description: Criteria carry a weight and a must-have versus nice-to-have flag, with Arabic capability still the hard gate.
checks.rule: Body and scorecard let the author set a weight and a must-have versus nice-to-have (MoSCoW) flag per criterion and take a weighted total, a candidate that fails any must-have is ruled out, and Arabic capability remains the existing hard gate applied before weighting that disqualifies a generative candidate regardless of weight, flag, or total.

checks.description: Recommends, never adopts or wires a tool.
checks.rule: Body states the skill proposes only and never adopts or wires a tool; adoption is a human (Ahmed) decision landing as a settings.json allowlist change.

checks.description: Names the open items that block a final decision.
checks.rule: Body and scorecard require listing the open items that block a final decision so a recommendation is not mistaken for a decision.
templates/build-vs-buy-scorecard.md exists and contains capability, existing-tool check, scored shortlist, recommendation, and open items sections.

checks.description: No em dash character anywhere in the skill files.
checks.rule: No file in this skill contains the U+2014 em dash character.
No Eastern Arabic numerals (U+0660 to U+0669) appear in any file; digits are 0-9 only.

checks.description: No tatweel or kashida in any Arabic text.
checks.rule: No file contains the U+0640 tatweel character.
